title: synthesis agent input
description: working_directory is the directory containing all specialist verdict files. review_id is the UUID from Step 1 of security-review.md.

working_directory.description: Absolute path to the directory containing all specialist agent verdict JSON files (go-index.json, authz-findings.json, oauth-checklist.json, invariant-results.json, taint-verdict-*.json). The synthesis agent reads from this directory per D18.

review_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session. This is the review_session_id from Step 1 of security-review.md. The synthesis agent uses it to populate review_id in the review-report/v1 output.
